# Merrow Migration Specimen Papers 2026

The revised specimen Paper 1 section and mark scheme for Migration, Empire and People c790-present, published by Merrow on 28 April 2026, downloaded the next morning.

## Summary

- One specimen section (4-, 8-, 12- and 16-mark questions plus the site study question) and its levels mark scheme.
- The 16-mark question follows the same four-level structure as Medicine, but the indicative content expects pupils to range across at least three of the four periods (c790-1500, 1500-1700, 1700-1900, 1900-present).
- The site study question uses an unseen source about the chosen port.

## Why It Matters

The board had promised these for January. Arriving on 28 April, with migration booklets only about 40% drafted, they were the main reason the [[history-department-meeting-2026-05-13|meeting of 13 May]] scaled the switch to a pilot in 10H1 and 10H3. I checked the 16-mark wording with [[samira-benyoussef]] on [[merrow-subject-officer-call-2026-05-06|6 May]].

## Caveats

One specimen section only, no exemplar answers until spring 2027. We are teaching to a mark scheme nobody has seen applied.
